visual_review: Full-resolution video time 24 s checked by coding agent: 3501 and 5089 bumper numbers agree with adjacent named boxes; partly hidden left robot is a real robot, not the person suggested by Haiku. This is a spot check, not independent human ground truth.
rejected_iterations: Appearance long-gap threshold too weak caused five wrong Einstein names; rejected and tightened.
Birth filtering dropped eight checked observations; corrected with repeated later identity anchors.
limitations: Haiku reviews both mixed; no confirmed swaps, unresolved visibility doubts.
Only two Glendale held-out frames, temporally near training frames and agent-reviewed.
Einstein coverage remains 39.4%; no claim of complete six-robot match tracking.
Glendale-specific detector regresses on original camera; original default preserved.
Hidden estimates up to two seconds are not observations.
